Puerto Ricans have been subjected to far too much abuse. We deserve a government that actually cares about our interests, that protects our health and well-being, and that doesn't keep passing legislation that makes it harder for us to live on our own island. And when we look at how many young Puerto Ricans have left over the last 25 years, that should terrify every single one of us who lives here and wants to see our people stay. To the Puerto Rican diaspora, this is an SOS. We need to work together. We need to support the people on the ground doing the work, push back against displacement, and fight for a future where Puerto Ricans can actually afford to live, raise their families, and grow old in their own homeland.
